notes: Achron's list is largely consistent. The only demonstrable gap is the missing duration for Hebrew Dance, Op. 35 No. 1; Heifetz-style performances run about 4 minutes. Queued opus numbers match Achron's known catalogue (Op. 29 and 45 sonatas, Op. 41 Suite bizarre, Op. 42 Scher, Op. 60 Concerto). Stimmungen, Op. 36 and Stimmungen, Op. 32 are treated as distinct opus groups, not duplicates. Levels are plausibly ordered: salon pieces at L4–5, Hebrew Melody and Hebrew Dance at L6–7, sonatas at L8, Concerto at L9.

fixes.reason: Hebrew Dance typically lasts about 4 minutes in performance.
